intro: Costa Rica has about 5% of the world's species in a country smaller than Scotland and Wales combined.

chapters.title: Volcanoes and forests
text: Arenal, Poás and Irazú are well-known volcanoes. Monteverde is a cloud forest, and Corcovado on the Osa Peninsula is one of the most biodiverse places on Earth. About a quarter of the country is protected.

chapters.title: Climate
text: It is tropical, with a rainy 'green season' from May to November.

keyTerms.meaning: A forest often covered in mist.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Costa Rica's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
